description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different source types—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—measured against the number of tokens used in a retrieval-augmented code generation task. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Tokens,” spans from 200 to 1000 in linear increments of 200. The y-axis, unlabeled but scaled from 10 to 40, likely represents a performance metric such as accuracy or F1 score, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The blue line with circular markers for “Tutorials” starts at approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rises steadily to about 29 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to 28 at 1000 tokens. The red line with circular markers for “Library Documentation” begins at 26, increases to 32 at 800 tokens, and then drops to 27 at 1000 tokens. The yellow line with circular markers for “StackOverflow posts” starts at 33, decreases steadily to 19 at 1000 tokens, showing the steepest decline among all sources. The green line with circular markers for “Github files” begins at 28, rises gradually to 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly falls to 30 at 1000 tokens. All lines are connected by solid lines, and the plot includes a legend in the upper left corner identifying each source by color and marker.
